answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the raven gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 180 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the ivory ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the whisper review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. That is 12 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
